raw_segments.text: No, not like that. A barren land, bare waste. Volcanic lake, the Dead Sea. No fish, weedless,
sunk deep in the earth. No wind could lift those waves, gray metal, poisonous foggy waters.
Brimstone they called it raining down, the cities of the plain, Sodom, Gomorrah, Edom.
All dead names. A Dead Sea and a Dead Land, gray and old. Old now. It bore the oldest,
the first race. A bent hag crossed from Cassidy's, clutching a nagging bottle by the neck. The
far away over all the earth, captivity to captivity, multiplying, dying, being born everywhere. It lay
there now. Now it could bear no more. Dead, an old woman's, the gray sunken cunt of the world.
